user.title: Connect ADT+
user.description: Paste your ADT+/Auth0 refresh token generated by a compatible local authentication helper. The token is stored in Home Assistant and is used to obtain short-lived access tokens. Do not share it.

location.title: Choose ADT+ location
location.description: Select the ADT+ location to add.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect ADT+
reauth_confirm.description: ADT/Auth0 rejected the saved refresh token. Generate a fresh ADT+ token with a compatible local authentication helper, then paste only the new refresh token here. Home Assistant will preserve this integration and its entities.

error.no_locations: Authentication succeeded, but no ADT+ locations were returned.
error.location_mismatch: The new token did not contain the ADT+ location already configured in Home Assistant.

abort.already_configured: This ADT+ location is already configured.
abort.missing_auth: Authentication information was lost. Start setup again.
